mapper.select: select r.review_id, r.vehicle_id, r.user_id, r.order_id, r.rating, r.content, r.image_url, r.is_anonymous, r.status, r.create_time, u.nick_name, v.model_name as vehicle_name from stad_vehicle_review r left join sys_user u on r.user_id = u.user_id left join stad_vehicle v on r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id where r.review_id = #{reviewId}
